block.guhs.pai_sho_tafel.lore: Take turns laying a tile; whoever lays a lotus first wins. Against a guh or against a friend.
block.guhs.theeset.lore: A cup of jasmine tea gives a small bonus. Put it in your guhhouse and the team comes over for tea.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_aank: After the Water Tribe, Appa Guh flies you to the Earth Kingdom. Land on the landing lobe in front of the enormous outer wall of &6Ba Sing Guh&r. The story starts by itself.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_aard: There's fighting in the Lower Ring. Nobody gets hurt, just a little pebbled. Go to the arena in the southwest.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_blin: &dToph Guh&r, The Blind Bandit, teaches you earthbending: with your eyes closed. Find the six earth coins in her training course. Crouching is stomping.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_joo_: &dJoo Dee Guh&r shows you the city. She smiles a lot.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_kamp: Go back to the camp. Something isn't right.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_koni: Maybe the &dEarth King Guh&r knows something. Or his bear Bosco.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_laog: Sneak into the base under the lake. Getting seen = back to the hall, nothing else. Crouching helps.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_loke: Nobody gets in without a stamp. Talk to the &dstrict desk guh&r in the gate building and answer his questions. Every answer is fine. Really.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_t: Uncle Miroh isn't in his tea house. Find the hill with the cherry tree.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_mono: Take the monorail from the outer wall to the Middle Ring. Every jump is a push with earthbending.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_pai_: Take turns laying a tile. Whoever lays a lotus first wins. Win or not: Uncle Miroh has something to say.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_thee: Make tea at the big kettle: water, leaves, pouring. Each time click right on time.
Somewhere in the Middle Ring it smells of jasmine. Find &dUncle Miroh&r's tea house. The waiter is... grumpy.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_h3_aarde_toph: At the camp someone is waiting with her feet in the grass. Then: on to the Fire Nation.
The Dai Li took Katara Guh to the crystal catacombs under the palace.
The Fall of Ba Sing Guh
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.monorail.uitleg: Jump (space) to push the car with earthbending. Crouch = get out.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.gelijk: The board is full: a draw.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.gewonne: You have a lotus! You win!
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.jij: Your turn: click an empty square.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.regels: Take turns laying a tile on an empty square. Whoever first has a lotus (a tile with four of their own tiles above, below, left and right of it) wins.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.verlore: The other has a lotus. Better luck next time, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.wacht: Who's playing along? Have someone click the table within ten seconds. Otherwise a guh of the house plays. (Click again: play a guh right away.)
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.pai_sho.wacht_k: The table is waiting for a second player...
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theeset.drink.0: Jasmine tea. For a moment you feel like a hero. A chonky hero.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theeset.drink.1: A cup of Uncle Miroh's recipe. Warm right up to your little ears.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theeset.drink.2: Tea! Your paws get faster. Or you think they do. Either is fine.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theeset.drink.3: Slurp. Ahhh. Exactly not too hot.
gui.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theeset.wacht: The tea still needs to steep a little. Try again in %s minute(s).
gui.guhs.kledingbron.einde2_h3_aarde: Chapter 3 of the Guhvatar: Ba Sing Guh
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_h3_aarde.r: After the Northern Water Tribe, Appa Guh flew for days over the void, on the way to the Earth Kingdom.
There lies Ba Sing Guh: a city with walls so high that even the clouds have to go around them.
Thousands of guhs live behind those walls. And all of them say nothing is going on.
Here you must learn earthbending. From the most stubborn teacher in the whole Guheinde.
And somewhere in the city a round old guh pours tea... for whoever walks in. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.belonin: The Cabbage Man's stall (once you've seen it break three times)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.doel.0: the landing lobe of Ba Sing Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.kort.14: Talk to Toph Guh at the camp
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.kort.3_: Find the six earth coins, blind
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.kort.4: Push the monorail to the Middle Ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.kort.6: Make tea at the big kettle
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.kort.7: Play Pai Sho with Uncle Miroh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.0: Land with Appa Guh on the landing lobe in front of the great outer wall of Ba Sing Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.1: Nobody enters Ba Sing Guh without a stamp. Talk to the strict desk guh at the outer gate.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.10: Appa is gone! Maybe the Earth King Guh knows more. Go to the throne room in the Upper Ring.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.11: Bosco smelled something at Lake Laogai. Sneak into the base under the lake, through the boat shed. Seen = back to the hall, so: crouch, wait, go.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.12: Uncle Miroh isn't in his tea house. Zuka knows where he is... or find the hill with the cherry tree on the landing lobe.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.13: The Dai Li took Katara Guh, deep under the palace. Go down with Uncle Miroh through the old gate in the palace garden.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.14: Ba Sing Guh has fallen. At the camp, someone who wants to come along is waiting for you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.2: Everybody in the Lower Ring is talking about the Earth Rumble. Go to the arena in the southwest of the Lower Ring.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.3: The Blind Bandit wants to teach you something. Talk to Toph Guh in the arena.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.3_ba: Close your eyes: step into the training course next to the arena. Crouching is stomping. Find the six earth coins in the floor.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.4: Take the monorail to the Middle Ring. You get in at the platform on top of the outer wall; jump to push the car with earthbending.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.5: Somewhere in the Middle Ring there is said to be a tea house where the tea tastes like heaven. Find The Jasmine Dragon.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.6: Uncle Miroh teaches you how to make tea. Click the big kettle in the kitchen, and again when the little gauge is in the green.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.7: Play a game of Pai Sho with Uncle Miroh: talk to him in the tea house.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.8: Joo Dee Guh, the city's guide, would love to show you around. She lives in the north of the Middle Ring.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.9: Time to look in on Appa Guh and Momo Guh. Go back to your camp on the landing lobe.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.nu.klaa: Earthbending learned, Appa Guh back, Toph Guh on the team. On to the Fire Nation!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.uitleg: The Earth Kingdom: a city with three rings of walls, a strict desk guh, a blind champion, a tea house that smells of jasmine... and a secret nobody says out loud. Learn earthbending, find Appa Guh again and survive the fall of Ba Sing Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.0: The landing lobe on the west side of Ba Sing Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.1: The desk in the gate building of the outer wall
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.10: The palace throne room, Upper Ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.11: The boat shed at Lake Laogai, Lower Ring east
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.12: The hill with the tree on the landing lobe
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.13: The old gate in the palace garden, Upper Ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.14: The camp on the landing lobe
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.2: The Earth Rumble arena, Lower Ring southwest
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.3: Toph Guh, in the Earth Rumble ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.3_: The walled training course next to the arena
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.4: The monorail platform on the outer wall
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.5: The Jasmine Dragon, Middle Ring west
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.6: The kitchen of The Jasmine Dragon
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.7: Uncle Miroh, in The Jasmine Dragon
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.8: Joo Dee Guh's house, Middle Ring north
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.9: The camp on the landing lobe
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhvatar_aarde.waar.kl: On Appa's back, on the way to the Fire Nation
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.aarde_geleerd: You learned earthbending! You feel the ground under your paws, and the ground feels you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.azula: Come closer, Guhvatar. I don't bite. I only shove. Very hard.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.dai_li.0: Move along, citizen. There is nothing to see here.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.dai_li.1: We are the Dai Li. We guard the culture of Ba Sing Guh. And the silence.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.dai_li.2: Do you have questions? Don't ask them.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.antwo: The Earth King is very busy. With important king things. He receives nobody.
War? Hee hee. In Ba Sing Guh we don't talk about... unpleasant things.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.knabb: There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.na.0: There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.na.1: What a lovely day! Hee hee. There is no nibble shortage.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.na.2: Hello! I'm Joo Dee Guh. ...Have we met?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.volge: Behind you, by the wall, there are suddenly two Dai Li Mikas. They're looking the other way. Very obviously. Better go back to the camp.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.vraag: What would you like to know? I know everything about Ba Sing Guh. Everything I'm allowed to know.
Does the city know the Fire Nation is waging war?
Is there enough to eat for everyone?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.joo_dee.welko: Welcome to Ba Sing Guh! I'm Joo Dee Guh. I'd be glad to show you everything. Everything there is to see.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kei.0: The Boulder Guh is not angry. The Boulder Guh is just a little... pebbled.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kei.1: The Boulder Guh now trains with smaller opponents. Pebbles. Gravel. Sand.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kei.2: A rock that falls gets back up. So says the Boulder Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.klaar: Chapter 3 is done: Ba Sing Guh. Toph Guh is part of the team. Appa Guh sets course for the Fire Nation...
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.klant.0: The tea here is so good. I come every day. Sometimes twice.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.klant.1: That waiter is so grumpy. I always give him an extra nibble. Maybe it'll help someday.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.klant.2: They say the old owner was once a very famous general. Nah. Look at him with that teapot.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.klant.3: Psst. There is no nibble shortage. So they say.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.0: A visitor! How lovely, I never get visitors. I'm the Earth King Guh, and this is Bosco. Bosco, say hello.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.1: You tell the king about Appa Guh. And about the Fire Nation, which has been grabbing nibbles for a hundred years.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.2: Your Majesty, the Guhvatar is tired from the journey. There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. And no sky bison.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.3: Bosco sniffs at your Appa whistle. His nose goes up. Then he turns and looks out of the window. At the lake.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.4: Bosco? What do you see there? Lake Laogai? But there's nothing there... Long Feng?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.6: Long Feng Mika looks at the lake too. Only for a moment. Just one second too long.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.na.0: I learn something new about my own city every day. Yesterday: there are POOR guhs in the Lower Ring. Who knew?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.na.1: Bosco misses Appa. They were almost friends.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.na.2: I got a pair of glasses. Now I see everything. Including what I'd rather not have seen.
Are you a visitor? Long Feng says I'm very busy. Am I busy? I don't know.
Bosco ate three honeycombs today. That's a record. I'm very proud of Bosco.
In my city everyone is happy. Long Feng says so. Long Feng knows everything.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.koning.waarhe: Long Feng lied to me? All these years? ...So there IS a nibble shortage?! Bosco, fetch the big nibble chest. We're going to share.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.boos.1: You! You're that guh from... Well. It was an accident. Right? RIGHT?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.boos.2: Twice! Two stalls! I'm going to build a stall of stone. Of earth coin. With a wall around it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.geef.0: Three stalls. Three! You know what? Take it with you. I'll build a new one.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.geef.1: It probably won't break so quickly with you. ...Right?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.hallo.0: Fresh cabbages! Crunchy cabbages! The finest cabbages in the whole Lower Ring!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.hallo.1: Cabbages, cabbages, cabbages! Mind my stall, it's new!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.hallo.2: A cabbage a day keeps the Mikas away. I always say that. Nobody believes it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.kapot.2: I moved to the Middle Ring. It's safe here, I thought... MY CABBAGES!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.kapot.3: The Upper Ring! Where nobody ever... MY CAAABBAGES!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.na.0: I built them all up again. All three. Please don't look at them.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.na.1: Cabbages! Fresh cabbages! At a safe distance from the Guhvatar!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.kool.na.2: My cabbages have become famous. Tourists come to look. At the wreckage.
You step aside for a cart full of tea crates, trip over a cabbage... and the whole stall collapses.
Momo Guh sees a cabbage. Momo Guh wants that cabbage. The stall thinks that's a bad idea.
Two Dai Li Mikas shoot past, under the ground. The stones go up. So do the cabbages.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.antwoor: The Guhvatar. Uh-huh. That's what they all say. Noted.
Guh. With a capital letter? Noted.
Sightseeing. Fine. The city is lovely. Nothing is going on.
The Earth King receives nobody. I'll just put down 'sightseeing'.
Plenty of nibbles in Ba Sing Guh. More than enough. I'll put down 'sightseeing'.
A lemur is not a Mika. He may come in. As long as he doesn't steal anything.
Nibbles aren't forbidden. Luckily, nyeg. I just had one myself.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.na.1: Your stamp is still valid. Next!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.na.2: I've already stamped two hundred times today. My paw hurts. Next!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.vraag.1: To speak to the Earth King.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.vraag.2: Are you carrying any Mikas, fire or forbidden nibbles?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.loket.wacht: Next! ...Oh. You're not here yet. First land, then queue, then a desk. That's how it works.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.long_feng.0: The king has no time. Move along.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.long_feng.1: Are you lost? The exit is that way. Very far away.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.long_feng.2: There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. I'll say it one more time, and then I'll say it one more time.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.heropen: Welcome back to The Jasmine Dragon! This is the best day of my life... after that time with the perfect jasmine tea. Sit down, the pot is always ready.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.na.0: Tea? Of course tea. Always tea.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.na.1: Zuka writes me every week. He says the nibbles in the Fire Nation are shared fairly now. I'm so proud.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.na.2: This cup is on the house. Actually, they all are.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.na.3: Sit down, Guhvatar. Even heroes may chonk for a while.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.pai_sho: A draw! The finest kind of result: nobody has to do the dishes.
You won! Ha! You're a natural. Or I'm getting old. Both, probably.
You know, in hard times guhs look for hope in others. But hope is something you give yourself, nyeg. That is inner strength.
Take this table with you. A game is only a game when you share it.
I won? Oh dear. Never mind. Losing is a game too, just with more tea.
Do you play Pai Sho? No? No matter. It's very simple: you take turns laying a tile, and whoever lays a lotus first wins. A tile with four petals around it. Shall we?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.thee.ui: Good tea is patience, nyeg. Click the kettle in the kitchen. The water must almost boil but not quite, the leaves must steep but not drown, and pour to the brim... but not over it. Click when the little gauge is in the green.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.vroeg: A new face! Come visit my tea house later, The Jasmine Dragon. Middle Ring, you'll smell it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.welkom: Sit down, sit down! Nobody leaves The Jasmine Dragon on an empty stomach.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.0: A nibble you save for later is also a little bit a nibble of now.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.1: Whoever only looks at the summit never sees the flowers along the path.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.2: Pride is a heavy backpack. Tea is a light one. Your choice.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.3: My nephew is like a kettle: lots of steam, but inside just warm water.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.4: A guh who falls is not a guh who lost. Only if he stays down.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.miroh.wijs.5: Pai Sho teaches you that the finest move is sometimes the move you don't make.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.omroeper.0: Next week in the Earth Rumble: the Blind Bandit against... anyone who dares!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.omroeper.1: Tickets for the Earth Rumble! Nibbles at the break! Nibbles before the break too!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.omroeper.2: Whoever beats the Blind Bandit gets a golden belt. Nobody has ever gotten it.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.sluip.begin: The base under Lake Laogai. Dai Li Mikas everywhere, looking to and fro. Crouching makes you quiet; behind their backs is safe.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.sluip.halt.0: Halt! Back to the hall, citizen.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.sluip.halt.2: There is nothing to see here. Really not. Back.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.sluip.halt.3: Lost? The exit is that way. Bye.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.gelukt: Perfect. A cup of tea like a warm blanket. Here, take my old tea set. I have two anyway... or three... or five.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.goed.0: Just right! The water is singing. Now the leaves.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.goed.1: Ah, can you smell that? Now pour. Gently.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.laat.0: Oh dear, now it's boiling. Boiling water makes jasmine bitter. Once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.laat.1: Too long. Now they've drowned in their own story. Once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.laat.2: Over the brim! Never mind, the table was thirsty too. Once more.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.ronde.0: First the water: click the kettle when the little gauge is in the green. Almost boiling, not quite!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.ronde.1: Then the leaves: let them steep, and click in the green.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.ronde.2: And now pour: almost full. Not over the brim!
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.vroeg.0: Not yet. The water still has to wake up.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.vroeg.1: Too early! The leaves haven't told their story yet.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.thee.vroeg.2: That's half a cup. Half a cup is half a friendship.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theebezoek.aa: Mmm! This tastes exactly like The Jasmine Dragon! Can I have another cup? And another?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theebezoek.ka: How cozy it is here. Your little house is as warm as your tea, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theebezoek.so: Tea is fine. But do you have nibbles with it too? Just asking. For the plan.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theebezoek.to: Tea is good. As long as we don't have to fly.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.theebezoek.zu: My uncle would be proud of you. Not of me. I dropped my cup.
Even a Fire Lord likes his tea. Especially this one. You learned it from the best.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.bezig: %s of the %s. Stomp, feel, walk. No peeking.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.geleerd: See? You see with your feet. You're still a pebble, but a pebble that listens.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.les.0: So you're the Guhvatar. You walk as if the ground owes you something.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.les.1: Earth isn't water. Earth doesn't wait until you're ready. Earth stands firm. You have to learn that too.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.les.2: Close your eyes. No, really closed. There, next to the arena, is my training course. Go in and feel.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.les.3: Every few seconds the ground trembles, and when you crouch you stomp yourself. Somewhere in the floor are six earth coins. Stand on all six. With your eyes closed, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.mee.0: So. Ba Sing Guh has fallen, the king is gone, and you're going to the Fire Nation. Right?
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.mee.2: Someone has to teach the Guhvatar that earth doesn't budge. You're all way too soft.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.mee.4: I HATE flying, nyeg. ...I'm coming along. And if anyone says a word about it, I'll stomp them off that bison.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.mee.5: Team Guhvatar is complete! Well... almost.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.na.0: I can see you coming, you know. With my feet.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.na.1: An earthbender stands firm. Even when everyone around him falls over.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.na.2: The Boulder Guh wants a rematch. The Boulder Guh doesn't get a rematch.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.na.3: I'm blind, not stupid. I know you just waved at me.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.ring: Watch closely. Well, watch. You know what I mean.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.toph.vroeg: What do you want? I'm fighting in a moment. Go sit in the stands, then at least I won't hear you.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.val.na: Appa flies you back to the camp. Someone is already waiting for you there, with her feet in the grass.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.volger.0: Us? We're not following anyone. We just happen to be walking the same way.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.lu_ten: My uncle? He's gone. To the hill outside the wall, the one with the tree. He goes there every year, on this day. ...Leave him be for a while. Or go to him. I don't care.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.ober.0: Tea. Yes. What kind of tea? ...I don't care. I'll just get tea.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.ober.1: I'm not a waiter. I'm... Never mind. I'm a waiter.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.ober.2: My uncle says I should smile more. This is my smile.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.ober.3: One more customer asking for 'the special nibble tea of the house'...
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.ober.4: Why are you looking at me like that? I have nothing to do with the Fire Nation. Nothing.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.val: Your friend. Katara Guh. The Dai Li took her, down, under the palace. My uncle is going with you. I... I'll see.
quest.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde.zuka.vroeg: We're not open yet. ...I mean: welcome. Says my uncle.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aankomst.begi: Ba Sing Guh. The walled city of the Earth Kingdom, on its own slab of cliff cheese in the void.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aankomst.hoop: We're safe here. And they're sure to help us against the Fire Nation.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aankomst.knab: And they're sure to have the biggest nibble market in the whole Guheinde!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aankomst.muur: Whoa. No Mika gets through that. Not even a really chonky one.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aankomst.poor: But first: the passport desk. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aardrommel.ba: And in that corner: the champion. Small, blind... and never beaten: THE BLIND BANDIT!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aardrommel.ji: You there, in the stands. Your feet are loud, nyeg. You stomp like a sky bison. Come down here in a bit.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aardrommel.ke: In this corner: the rock that never budges, the pebble that never cracks... THE BOULDER GUH!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aardrommel.ro: The Boulder Guh is ready to rock!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_aardrommel.ve: The Boulder Guh... feels... rather beaten.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_appa_ontvoerd: Appa roared. But hands of stone hold even a sky bison very still.
Day one. They took him under the city, deep under Lake Laogai, where the light never comes.
Day two. Appa didn't eat. He only looked at the little hole in the ceiling, where sometimes a cloud drifted by.
Day three. A Dai Li Mika threw him a cabbage. Appa sniffed it... and thought of your hands, which always smelled of nibbles.
While you walked through the city, Appa Guh was napping by the camp. Momo Guh slept on his head.
At the camp there is only a tuft of white fur left.
Easy, big fella. You're going to stay with us for a while.
Momo Guh fled into the bushes. He watched until they were gone.
Momo Guh comes out of the bushes and presses against your leg. His little ears are completely flat.
And every night he hummed very softly. So you would hear him, if you ever came near.
Appa is gone. Someone in this city knows where he is.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_jasmijn_draak: Zuka looks at you for a very long time. Then he turns away and polishes a cup that was already clean.
The Jasmine Dragon. It smells of jasmine, warm nibbles... and very faintly of Fire Nation.
Will you help me with a pot of tea? The kettle is in the kitchen. I'll teach you, nyeg.
I'm not your nephew... I mean: yes, uncle. Of course, uncle.
Sharing tea with a stranger guh is one of the true chonkinesses of life.
Welcome, welcome! Come in, sit down. The tea is almost ready.
A cup of tea with a sour face tastes sour too, nephew.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_knipoog_mewtw: Somewhere, something pink giggles. Nobody looks.
He's here of his own free will. Really. We can't get him out anymore.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_knipoog_sjokk: On the wall between the rings, Shuckly crawls along. He has come a very long way. He thinks.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_loket.papiere: Form 3B, form 7Q and the declaration of chonkiness... also in order.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_loket.poort: With a heavy sigh, the bars of the outer gate slide up.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_loket.welkom: Welcome to Ba Sing Guh. Everyone is safe here. And there is no nibble shortage here.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.dit: Oh no? Then what's THAT, behind those bars? A really big pillow?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.kna: And there is no nibble shortage either. Understand? In Ba Sing Guh, nothing is ever going on.
Well done, Guhvatar. All the way down here, without waking a single Dai Li Mika.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.lie: You lied to the whole city. The Earth King knows nothing!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.nie: But there is nothing to see here. There is no sky bison in Ba Sing Guh.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.tra: Behind the bars, in the dark: something big and white. Something humming very softly.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_long_feng.weg: The Earth King knows exactly what I tell him. ...Dai Li, we're leaving.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.delen: Some nibbles you share, even when there is no one left to share them with.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.1: Over the hills, through the grass and the wind,
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.2: walks a young guh who is still just a kid.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.3: His helmet's too big and his little ears ache,
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.4: the moon shows the road that his tired feet take.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.5: The lantern is burning, the tea's waiting here,
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.6: the pillow lies soft, as it does every year.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.7: Lay down your spear, for the night is so mild,
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_lu_ten.lied.8: sleep now, little guh, we are waiting, my child.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.ga: Go! All of you! I'll keep them busy for a bit, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.gevallen: Ba Sing Guh had fallen. But the Guhvatar was still alive, and flew away on the back of a sky bison.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.kristal: Under the palace the crystals glow green. Here you found Katara Guh again. And Zuka.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.miroh: Behind you, the Dai Li Mikas close Uncle Miroh in, in a cage of green crystal. He watches you go. And nods.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.nu: There are too many of them! Guhvatar, the Guhvatar State. NOW!
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.ogen: A cool glow. Your eyes open. Katara Guh laughs through her tears.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.reunie: How cozy. A family reunion, deep under the ground.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.staat: Your eyes glow. The air around you hums. For a moment you feel every Guhvatar who came before you.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.stil: It is very quiet in the crystal chamber. Zuka looks at his uncle. Then at his sister.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.titel: The Fall of Ba Sing Guh
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.val: The lightning hits you right in the glow. You fall. It goes quiet and dark in your head.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.water: The spirit water of the North Pole... please. Please, let it work.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.weg: Zuka. Is it your own path, or a path someone else is laying out for you?
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_val.zuka: Zuka, dear brother. Choose. Come home with me... or stay with your tea uncle.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_weerzien.appa: Appa Guh lifts his big head. He sniffs. He sniffs again.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_weerzien.krak: You stomp. The floor trembles. The bars bend open as if they were made of clay.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_weerzien.lik: A big, wet, warm tongue. You're soaked from head to toe. You couldn't care less.
scene.guhs.einde2_h3_aarde_weerzien.thui: Come on, let's go home. All of us.
